$description: Script overrides for Sinhala (si) and Tamil (ta) — edu-theming-criteria C4. The build applies them to every type token: CSS :lang(si|ta) blocks re-declare the --merit-type-* parts; Dart gets MeritTypeScaleSi / MeritTypeScaleTa. Numeric styles are skipped (digits stay Latin). Display family = styles set in fontFamily.display.
